summary: Liquidity Services Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to furnish the transcript of its earnings conference call held on May 7, 2026. The filing is a routine current report providing management's prepared remarks and forward-looking statements. No extraordinary corporate event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring, is disclosed. The filing serves solely as a regulatory update on financial results and company performance. There are no deal terms, activist campaigns, or strategic reviews mentioned. The filing is purely informational and does not constitute a special situation.
